citation_form.description: Dictionary headword: nouns singular, adjectives masculine singular, verbs infinitive. No elided forms (l'eau), no plurals, no conjugations.

script_allow.note: The build filter drops apostrophes and hyphens, so the bank holds neither (non-goal this sweep, Eric 2026-11-05).

keyboard_notes: Five accented vowels and ç by long-press. oe and ae for œ and æ are the stand-ins French writers use (most keyboards lack œ): accepted on Easy and Spell Jr, close above. The French rectifications of 1990 are accepted both ways through the variants file.
